{{Quote|Death to the Baroness!|The mind controlled Senate Guard|<ref name="Last" />}}
The '''assassination attempt on Baroness Omnino''' was a false-flag attempt on [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]]'s life. It was orchestrated by Omnino herself with the goal of gaining sympathy from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during her long-running conflict against the [[Vena Isolationists]], as well as discrediting the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Baroness [[Mind control device|mind-controlled]] a [[Unidentified Senate Guard (mind control)|Senate Guard]] into trying to kill her, but he only managed to take out her [[Omnino's bodyguard|bodyguard]] in the process, since [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], disguised as a [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], intervened.
